finding: Process termination leaves receipt pending indefinitely; browser fences new operations until terminal acknowledgment. No expiry previously existed.

repair.lateCompletion: Expired transition is committed before rejection outside transaction; later save is fenced
repair.textBudget: Admission remains counted once; same UUID never readmits or reinvokes provider
repair.refineBudget: Expire only pending/no-generation receipt; validate subscription actor and service, release matching period reservation once atomically
repair.completed: Never expires or refunds completed receipts; image retention still applies
repair.storage: Apply updates conversation only after durable matching-intent consumption succeeds

limitations: Synthetic provider/session data; no paid calls/customer production DB writes
